audit.why: Favoured lane at 4/10 matches the data (66.67% over 9 games) and matches the mirror: Nasus is a dash-less melee who has to walk into Lillia's Q ring to stack, and his only answer, Wither, is on 15/14/13/12/11s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's First item row was marked Skill 4/10 and the 2+ items row Skill 5/10, while the content layer's whys say the first-item burn spike is hers and the fully-stacked late game is his.
audit.why: Liandry's/Riftmaker turn W and the Dream Dust passive into percent-HP damage against Nasus's large drain-tank body — a clear Lillia window. By 2+ items his stacked Siphoning Strike, Spirit Fire armour shred and Fury of the Sands lifesteal out-sustain her DoT, so that row belongs to him.
audit.corrected: First item flipped to Lillia 7/10; 2+ items flipped to Nasus 3/10 with a why that states the reclaim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said WHY Wither is fatal — it was tracked as a generic threat with no cooldown and no statement of what it removes.
audit.why: Lillia has no dash; her entire escape is Blooming Blows' stacking Move Speed, which is exactly the stat Wither decays. Confirmed from the Nasus-side audit already on disk. Her Q outer ring is true damage, so his Spirit Fire armour shred and R armour/MR do not reduce it; her R only sleeps targets already carrying Dream Dust from her passive.
audit.corrected: Don't line rewritten to name Wither's 15s rank-1 cooldown and state that it deletes the move speed that is her only kite.

audit.why: The packet flagged zero sequencing cues, but dosFull[2].d already carries the concrete line ('Nasus burns Wither on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation'), which matches the rank-1 cooldown. The new Don't adds the second cue.

edits.after: Neither of you does anything at 1 — farm from range and deny the first Siphoning Strike stacks he wants.

edits.before: You're a teamfight nightmare now: sleep two, kite the rest, and let the burn do the bookkeeping.
edits.after: A fully-stacked Nasus reclaims it — Wither shuts off your kite and his Q plus R lifesteal out-sustain you.
